The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: Iran School Bombing: The Search For Truth
original_title: Iran School Bombing: The Search For Truth
overview: On the first day of the war in Iran, a primary school in the remote town of Minab was bombed. 156 people died, including 120 pupils and 26 of their teachers.  Ever since people have demanded answers. Who was behind it? Was it a terrible mistake? If so, how could such a horrific accident have been allowed to happen?  Many have pointed the finger at the United States. But in June President Trump told Sky News "I don't think it was  who might be responsible. Sky News has spent the four and a half months since the attack investigating what happened, how it happened and Sky's Dominic Waghorn reports from the town - the first journalist from a major western news organisation to go there - where he speaks to survivors, bereaved parents and emergency workers.

title: Disney+ Insider: National Geographic Museum of Exploration
original_title: Disney+ Insider: National Geographic Museum of Exploration
overview: Step inside the National Geographic Museum of Exploration with National Geographic Explorer Andrés Ruzo alongside “Descendants: Wicked Wonderland” actress Kiara Romero. Disney+ Insider unveils a space designed to spark curiosity and inspire discovery. From the museum’s striking, canyon-inspired architecture to its four thematic areas—Spark, Trek, Purpose, and Impact—each experience highlights the power of exploration. Along the way, rare artifacts, hands-on interactive spaces, and immersive exhibitions bring science, storytelling, and conservation to life. The experience builds to a powerful invitation: to see the world differently, embrace an Explorer’s mindset, and step into a future shaped by curiosity, wonder, and purpose.

Part of "4x4: Contemporary Art in Chicago" - Season 1

title: Bare Roots
overview: AMY reluctantly returns home to the windy clifftop in North Cornwall where she grew up, after a break-up with her partner Jess has left her homeless. She hopes her mum, SUE, will be pleasantly surprised at the chance for them to reconnect. But Sue isn't good with surprises, and has other things on her mind. She is preparing to plant a bare root hedge, her final act of resistance against the second home development that will surround her home, concreting over her memories and erasing her past. They start early: digging in the hedge is backbreaking work. When Amy finally manages to tell Sue about her loss, Sue is lost for words. They doggedly continue planting, gradually finding a rhythm together in the silence. As night falls, and exhaustion sets in, Sue returns to the house, and Amy is left in the field, digging the last trench for the remaining plants. Alone, they each find a way to reach out across the silence, the years of separation, and their losses, towards each other.

title: Vera
overview: Vera is an experimental film that combines drawn-on-film and digital animation. The images unfold to the rhythm of music played by Vera Guilaroff, a pianist from Quebec that has now been forgotten by history. Guilaroff accompanied numerous silent films in Montreal movie theaters during the 1910s and 1920s. To our knowledge, this is the first time in nearly 100 years that her music has been used again in a film.

title: Charlie and Carol

title: The Candy World Movie
overview: In the magical Candy World, a powerful Fountain of Sweetness begins to corrupt after losing its friend and decides to destroy the world to create a new one. As chaos spreads across the candy land, a kind jelly named Baddy discovers the truth and tries to stop it. Instead of fighting, Baddy attempts to heal the Fountain’s pain and save Candy World before everything is erased.

title: One Thousand Voices
overview: The deconstruction of a local music band, it’s people and it’s values. A group of friends, Isabella, Isaiah, Pierce and Ethan navigate their personal values creating music about change and their identities. They have important conversations about the way they view their identities and debunk normative myths created by societal expectations. As they spend time together they love and create memories of importance showing the significance of creativity.

title: Oldmans Woods
overview: A camping vlogger, Jason a.k.a. Camping with J-Dog, goes to investigate the legend of the Cult of Father Grimm who are rumored to be living out in Oldmans Woods. Despite the warnings of the locals, Jason explores the woods and finds more than he bargained for.

title: Silver Rush
overview: Silver Rush is a thrilling 12-minute documentary that follows the incredible journey of salmon along Alaska’s Kenai River. The film chronicles the salmon’s perilous migration from the river’s mouth, where they face dipnetters to the Russian River, where they fight their way up waterfalls. Along the way, they encounter predators such as eagles and bears, as they work to reach their spawning grounds. Highlighting their critical role as a keystone species, Silver Rush underscores the essential connection between the salmon, Alaska’s ecosystems, and its people, illustrating how this species’ survival is vital to the region's balance and prosperity.

title: Stumble Then Rise On Some Awkward Morning
original_title: Stumble Then Rise On Some Awkward Morning

title: From Lassen, With Love
overview: In Northern California’s Lassen National Forest, wildlife biologist Alyssa enters ground zero of the 2021 Dixie Fire—one of the largest and most severe wildfires in state history. overview: A ragtag team of seasoned investigators and eager newcomers descend upon a centuries-old mansion hidden deep in the heart of South Carolina, where whispered legends and unsolved tragedies blur the line between history and the haunted.

title: Julius Ceaser Returns
overview: The definitive cut of two high school short films in a style that mesh's both ideas together! After Julius Ceaser's daughter becomes the new heir to the throne, a bet is made to assassinate her.

title: The Internship
overview: A CIA-trained assassin recruits other graduates from her secret childhood program, The Internship, to violently destroy the organization. The CIA fights back with deadly force.

title: Final Transmission
overview: Alone aboard a crippled transport drifting through deep space, Commander Elias Walker records what will become humanity’s final message. Earth is gone, and the ship, once a vessel of hope, now carries only failure and silence. As oxygen fades, Elias begins a calm mission log, clinging to duty and procedure. But as systems die around him, the truth surfaces: he isn’t just facing his own death, he’s witnessing the extinction of mankind.  In his final moments, the soldier becomes a storyteller, offering not a plea for rescue but a quiet eulogy for the human race. As the ship falls silent, his voice becomes the last echo of humanity, ending with a single, hopeful line:  “I hope the stars remember us.”

title: Salt of the Earth
overview: In the aftermath of a global collapse, a police officer and his crime-boss sister navigate a dystopian world in search of his rabies-infected son.

title: Abish Mathew: Finish
overview: Stand-up special by Abish Mathew

title: Bombshell
overview: Eighty years after the devastating atomic bombings that ushered in the nuclear age, Bombshell explores how the U.S. government manipulated the narrative about the atomic bombings of the Japanese cities Hiroshima and Nagasaki. Through propaganda, censorship and the co-opting of the press, the government presented a benevolent picture of atomic power, minimizing the horrific human toll. Bombshell sheds light on the efforts of a group of intrepid reporters to let the world know the truth.

title: Blood and Betrayal
overview: A thriving restaurant and a crime lord-when passion and revenge intertwine, love can be just as deadly as a loaded gun. Eva is married to the owner of a restaurant in the downtown London back alleys. However, when she begins an passionate affair with another man and the couple begin being black mailed £500,000 otherwise their secret will be exposed a shocking twist of erotic gun violence breaks.

title: Keramat Gunung Jerai
overview: Three close friends, Hakim (Niezam Zaidi), Junaidi (Iedil Dzuhrie Alaudin) and Wan (Akmal Asyraf), are determined to climb Mount Jerai to perform a forbidden ritual. They are drawn to the existence of a mysterious stone believed to be capable of granting any human desire. From that night onwards, their lives change completely. Success comes unexpectedly, as if some supernatural force is constantly fulfilling their every dream. However, all this wealth and pleasure comes at an extremely high price. Gradually, mysterious disturbances begin to haunt their lives and the situation becomes increasingly dark day by day. At the same time, Wan disappears without any word. Years later, a new tragedy strikes when Hakim's young daughter, Laila (Kis Aisha), is afflicted with a strange illness that defies all logic. Desperate and consumed by guilt, Hakim decides to return to Mount Jerai with Junaidi, hoping to correct the mistakes they once made.

title: Yes! Captain Zul Aaryan
overview: The story follows Zul Aaryan, a pilot and CEO, who chooses to close his heart after being betrayed by his ex-lover. However, everything changes when he meets Zara Andrea, a bold intern trainer who is not easily submissive to anyone. Their relationship, which initially is filled with quarrels, sarcasm and disagreements, eventually transforms when family pressure brings them into an unexpected bond. The question is, can these two people who often clash recognize each other's hearts and find love beyond all the conflict?

title: Kasih Yang Terkorban
overview: A forbidden love between an heir and a worker's child is destroyed by greed and social status, but twenty years later, the resurfacing of a dark secret reveals the mystery of a lost child, family betrayal, and smoldering revenge.

title: Jutawan Ekspres 2
overview: Yusni (Elly Mazlein) and Yunoh (Rashidi Ishak) return with a new determination to become millionaires. However, as before, their journey proves to be not as easy as they had hoped when they become trapped in a questionable investment opportunity. Without realizing it, they have actually become victims of a suspicious scheme that may be connected to Amir (Bell Ngasri), a man they have long believed to be dead. At the same time, their neighbors, Datuk Kadir (Azhar Sulaiman) and his wife, Datin Maimon (Sazzy Falak), play an important role in helping to save Yusni and Yunoh's marriage, which is beginning to show signs of strain. Facing various challenges and trials, the couple must find ways to overcome their financial problems and strengthen their relationship again before the situation becomes even more complicated.

title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
overview: Trapped between love and loyalty, the fate of three people changes forever because of one choice that haunts them for years. Telling the story of Uwan, an elderly citizen who suffers from dementia. As his memories of daily life gradually fade, his memory seems to remain trapped in 1988. In every moment that passes, Uwan continuously mentions the name of a village girl named Laila, which raises various questions among his family members. The effort to unravel the mystery behind that name ultimately leads them to an old love story that was never resolved. Bit by bit, secrets kept for decades begin to be revealed, showing how jealousy, life choices and sacrifice have changed the destiny of several individuals.

title: Kerana Sayang Aku Tinggalkan
overview: Imran and Airien have been married for 8 years but have not been blessed with children because Airien is still not ready. This puts Imran under stress. Furthermore, Airien's attitude of not paying attention to household management matters such as cooking, cleaning, doing laundry and others adds to his burden. Yana appears, having just lost her husband who was also Imran's close friend. Imran begins to care for Yana and desires to propose to her. This matter comes to Airien's knowledge and causes Airien to become distressed and begin attacking Yana.

title: Bulan Henti Bicara
overview: # Translated Synopsis  The story follows Zulfa (played by Ezzanie Jasny), a girl from a fisherman's family who is willing to sacrifice her love for Afghan (Ali Reza) in order to marry her father's choice, Jamali (Azhan Rani), a wealthy businessman presumed capable of guaranteeing a brighter future. However, the happiness she expected turns into a nightmare. Behind his image of piety and respect in society, Jamali actually harbors a hidden agenda. After marriage, Zulfa becomes trapped in a relationship filled with manipulation and emotional abuse, while simultaneously forced to face the bitter reality of being a second wife. The conflict intensifies when Zulfa lives under the same roof as Jamali's first wife, Faziah (Azar Azmi), who is consumed by suspicion and hostility. The appearance of Nazif (Qireen Din), who accuses her of being an immoral woman, further deepens Zulfa's wounds.

title: Di Kaki Langit Timur
overview: Bal, a teenager who runs away from family conflict, begins a new life at a chalet on the East Coast. He meets several individuals who are also facing their own conflicts and dreams. His presence eventually helps reconcile the relationship between Maria and her adopted daughter, Imani, so that Imani's dream receives approval.

title: Lunatik : Amukan Dendam
overview: The story of teenagers who are college students go camping in a forest without realizing that among them there is someone who harbors a long-standing grudge against the others due to being bullied all this time. What will happen during their camping trip?

title: Diagnosis Cinta
overview: # The Reunion of Dr. Maira and Dr. Zane  The reunion of Dr. Maira and Dr. Zane reignites a love story that never truly ended, while family secrets, medical ethical dilemmas, professional rivalry and past trauma test every decision made. Dr. Maira begins her practice as an expert oncology trainer, but is shocked by the sudden return of Dr. Zane, the man who once broke her heart. As they face various cancer patient cases, their professional relationship becomes increasingly complicated when it is revealed that Wanie, a teenage patient, is Zane's half-sister who was left with their biological mother long ago. Past trauma, guilt and family conflict begin to disturb Zane's focus, while Maira increasingly understands the wounds he has hidden. The appearance of Aris, a child confirmed to have leukemia, tests the competence and humanitarian values of the entire medical team. A debate erupts between conventional treatment approaches and experimental clinical trials brought by Prof.

title: Dune Runner

title: Alpacas!
overview: Do you know what an Alpaca is?

overview: An ongoing series of found landscapes, filmed on a single 8mm roll.

title: Bodyhackers
overview: An environmental activist Denver Blake has decided to expose a cosmetics corporation that he believes is exploiting the insecurities caused by societal beauty standards. However, when he falls in love with Renée, a former ballerina obsessed with constantly improving her beauty, he becomes drawn into a mesmerizing underworld of plastic surgery.
